# Synthetic Legal Review Fixture

`materials.json` contains four fictitious statements created for the worked documentation example. `review_record.json` identifies that file and records hypothetical conditions while preserving an actual HOLD. Neither file is a legal opinion or training authorization.

The example does not review or clear any real TR paper, standard, licence, model or client dataset. It is not consumed by the training runtime. The [worked explanation](../../../../docs/legal-review/ILLUSTRATIVE_LEGAL_REVIEW_WORKED_EXAMPLE.md) states the assumptions and the real-review boundary.
